title: Undo a sample transaction
summary: A transaction can keep related changes together.
introduction: A transaction can keep related changes together. Your task: Explain why the table was created before BEGIN TRANSACTION.
learningObjectives: Explain why the table was created before BEGIN TRANSACTION.
Explain the example for undo a sample transaction

blocks.text: A transaction can keep related changes together. ROLLBACK cancels changes made within it to a normal temporary table.
Use SQL Server 2019+ in a separate practice database with a SQL editor. T-SQL is different from the SQLite engine on this site, so these examples are for that separate tool.

blocks.title: Undo a sample transaction

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `ROLLBACK` cancels the applicable uncommitted changes. It cannot undo an earlier committed transaction.
`SELECT` names the output values. `AS` can give a calculated result a readable column name.

blocks.text: The temporary table remains, but rows_left is 0 because the insert was rolled back.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Table variables have different rollback behaviour. This example deliberately uses a # temporary table.

blocks.text: Explain why the table was created before BEGIN TRANSACTION.
